display_long_description:
WELCOME TO DEADLOCK CITY

Enter Deadlock City's vehicle-combat tournament, broadcast by Barnaby Boone, owner and voice of Arena Radio.

Choose your car, step into the VR cockpit, and survive escalating waves of rival drivers, zombies, and the dangerous Agents of Chaos. Ram enemies into traps, fire mounted weapons, use nitro, dodge bombs and cranes, and stay out of the acid.

[media]

BUILD YOUR COMBAT CAR

Unlock vehicles and equip spikes, guns, flares, damage boosts, and survival upgrades. Create a build focused on damage, control, or endurance.

[media]

CLIMB THE LEADERBOARDS

Fight through short, replayable runs, improve your score, and compete on Global and Friends leaderboards.

[media]

FEATURES

• First-person VR cockpit driving
• Arcade demolition and vehicle combat
• Rival drivers, Agents of Chaos, and zombies
• Weapons, nitro, upgrades, traps, and moving hazards
• Physics-driven crashes, flips, and explosions
• Seated or standing play
• Co-op mode coming soon

[media]
[media]

Car Crash Arena is in Early Access and continues to grow through updates, including new arenas, Racing Mode, vehicles, upgrades, and gameplay improvements.

[media]

Welcome to Deadlock City. Survive the tournament and earn your place among its champions.

[media]
[media]
[media]
